newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish government vows to speed up bank sales.
newsitem.headline: Turkish government vows to speed up bank sales.

text.p: The new Turkish government of Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz vowed on Monday to speed up the privatisation of state banks.
"Work on selling state banks will be increased," said a government document to be read out in parliament later in the day.

"The supervision of state banks will also be increased so as to fill legal gaps and get rid of structural faults in the state banking sector," said the document, a blueprint for future government action.
Government officials say around four state banks are ready to be sold off if the political will were present.
The document also said the government would speed up the sale of Turk Telekom.
The constitutional court earlier this year approved the privatisation of the telecommunications giant.
